title: First take on sourdough discard Brown Butter chocolate chip cookies!!...
description: First take on sourdough discard Brown Butter chocolate chip cookies!! Thank you @zoeisabellegordon for this insane recipe.  Ingredients * 110g butter, browned * 188g all-purpose flour * ½ tsp baking powder * ½ tsp baking soda * ¾ tsp salt * 110g sugar * 110g light brown sugar * 1 large egg yolk (room temp) * 115g sourdough starter discard * 2 tsp vanilla paste or high-quality extract * Mix of semi-sweet, dark, and/or milk chocolate chips Instructions 1.Brown the butter * Add 110g butter to a saucepan over medium heat. *Melt, then continue cooking until it foams, turns golden, and smells nutty. *Remove from heat immediately. *Let cool 10–15 minutes so it doesn’t cook the egg yolk. 2. Mix dry ingredients In a bowl, whisk together: * 188g flour * ½ tsp baking powder * ½ tsp baking soda * ¾ tsp salt Set aside. 3. Mix wet ingredients In another bowl, combine: *Slightly cooled brown butter *110g sugar *110g light brown sugar Mix well. Add: *1 egg yolk *115g sourdough discard *2 tsp vanilla Stir until smooth and glossy. 4. Combine wet + dry *Pour the dry ingredients into the wet mixture. *Stir until combined  *Fold in your chocolate chips (use a LOT for bakery vibes). 5. Chill the dough *Chill the dough for 1–2 hours in fridge *Overnight is best! 6. Bake!! *Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). *Bake for 12-13 min #sourdoughstarter #sourdoughdiscardrecipe #brownbuttercookie
